Name: Sebastian Is Gone
Author: ConsciouslyLazy
Description:
[i][size=3]Sometimes we get to learn the hard way.

[/size][/i][b][size=5]This mod... [/size][/b]
[b]Adds a storyline after you give Sebastian a bouquet at 8 hearts. Afterwards, he moves to Zuzu City, leaving you behind.[/b]
[spoiler] He will eventually come back, after one season. [/spoiler]

Provides a backstory between vanilla 8 and 10 heart events. Adds a few events, dialogue, and items.

Does NOT edit any existing heart events.
Starts to take action when you give a bouquet to Sebastian and ends when he becomes your boyfriend.

Is [u]incompatible[/u] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url].


[b][size=5]Warning[/size][/b]
Vanilla heart events(2, 4, 6, 8) will not be triggered once Sebastian leaves Pelican Town.
If you're using other mods that add new events, those will be triggered regardless.
For immersive experience, make sure you've seen all of Sebastian's heart events before giving him a bouquet.

This mod has not been tested in multiplayer.


[b][size=5]Event Preconditions[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]The Start of Everything[/size][/b]
Reach 8 hearts with Sebastian. [b]Wait one day at this point.[/b] If you give a bouquet the day you reached 8 hearts, Sebastian might just gladly accept it.

[b][size=3]Event 1[/size][/b]
[spoiler]Give a bouquet to Sebastian. He will say sorry to you. Your bouquet will not disappear since he is rejecting it.
Go to the Mountain on a rainy night. (6:00 PM - 2:00 AM)[/spoiler]

[b][size=3]Event 2 (Optional. Abigail event)[/size][/b]
[spoiler]Reach 2 hearts with Abigail. While Sebastian is gone, (after Event 1 and before Event 3) enter Pierre's General Store.[/spoiler]

[b][size=3]Event 3[/size][/b]
[spoiler]A season and a day after Sebastian left, you will receive a letter from him. Make sure you read this letter. The event will be triggered the next day, when you leave the farmhouse.[/spoiler]


[b][size=5]Potential Issues[/size][/b]
This mod literally 'deletes' Sebastian from Stardew Valley to a certain extent. (Deletes Entry "Sebastian" from Data/Characters.) I have no idea if this will cause errors in certain situations, though it seems ok for me. I had to do this to prevent Sebastian from coming to festivals, including modded ones. I may compromise and allow him to attend festivals in the updated version, if a critical bug is reported. So far, so good.

And yes, [b]events are safe from errors[/b]: I tested and Sebastian appears normally in events. As I said above, this mod deletes Sebastian to a certain extent - but not completely, since events work just fine after deleting the character. I know this practice is potentially dangerous, but there's no reason I shouldn't use it if it works.

One thing not tested:
[spoiler]Sebastian's shop at the Desert Festival might result in glitches or game crash.[/spoiler]
If someone has this problem, please let me know.

[size=4][b]Solution[/b][/size]
If you are still worried, download the [b]Stability[/b] version.


[b][size=5]Translations[/size][/b]
[b]Spanish[/b] translation by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194082642-devy003/]devy003[/url] is included.
